meta_description: oprah on October 6, 2026: "My next @oprahsbookclub selection is “Hungered” by @amandarizkalla. This riveting new novel from a first-time author compassionately tackles the difficult subject of families living unhoused and outside the margins, making us see not only their struggles, but also their hopes, dreams, and the perseverance it takes to face another day. Pick up a copy wherever you get your books, and watch our spoiler-free conversation wherever you get the @oprahpodcast.".
